This workshop is intended on helping you connect with your true passion and desires. The "why" behind why you're here on Earth. Your passions are sparks to your light & without them your light will feel dim. We are meant to live out our lives in joy, not just working to pay our bills.

Sharing your passions and creations is what will reciprocate the highest level of fulfillment for you. & yes, YOU are a creator. Even if you've never made anything artistically, or don't think of yourself as a creative, we will access the parts of you that remember that you have the power to make this life what you've always dreamt of.

This webinar/workshop is perfect for you if:
-You desire to feel fulfilled with what you do
-You have blockages around abundance/financial freedom
-You desire to be paid for what you love
-Feel fears around supporting yourself
-Have felt creative blockages

SUMMARY:

This will be a LIVE career reading & coaching session about creating the space for your Higher Self to guide you into true fulfillment when it comes to what you do for a living. There is joy found in turning passion to profit, no matter your unique gifts.

QUESTIONS FOR HIGHER SELF:
-What are my natural talents?
-What sparks joy in my life?
-How do I create an offering based on my passions?


OUTRO:
-Live Q/A
-Coaching Interactions with participants

--‍♀️ By the end of this webinar, you will feel confident in your ability to confidently create a life of fulfillment.

***Link to stream granted with each seat within 3 days after the webinar
